title: Low and Flow
description: A bilingual (Greek and English) online store for a local bike shop, built on EmDash and Astro and running at the edge on Cloudflare Workers, with card payments via Alpha Bank and BOX NOW locker delivery.
features: Full product catalog with category tiles, brand pages and faceted filters.
Fast typo-tolerant search with accent and Greeklish matching and live suggestions.
Greek and English storefronts sharing the same catalog and slugs.
Product pages with a generic variant picker, gallery and specs.
Cart drawer and checkout with card, IRIS, bank transfer and pay on delivery.
BOX NOW locker map picker, courier and store pickup delivery options.
Wholesale accounts with application, approval and private pricing.
Custom admin for orders, stock, product editing and email notifications.
Edge-cached pages with on-the-fly image resizing for fast loads.
